Question: What is the average policy size which is the the total amount of premium divided by the number of policies?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier), 0) AS average_policy_size
FROM Premium pr
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier;

What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.policy_holder,
    COALESCE(prm.total_premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
            WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
            WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
            WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_loss
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        MAX(CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS varchar(50))) AS policy_holder
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICYHOLDER'
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
) ph
    ON ph.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS total_premium_amount_paid
    FROM Premium pr
    INNER JOIN Policy_Amount pa
        ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
) prm
    ON prm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.policy_holder,
    prm.total_premium_amount_paid
ORDER BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number;

    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premiums_Paid
FROM Premium pr
INNER JOIN Policy_Amount pa

What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid, the catastrophe it had, and the agent who sold it?
Generated Query:
WITH claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premium_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    INNER JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holder AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        apr.Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code IN ('POLICYHOLDER', 'POLICY_HOLDER', 'INSURED')
),
agent AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        apr.Party_Identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code IN ('AGENT', 'BROKER', 'PRODUCER')
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder,
    COALESCE(pm.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    ag.Party_Identifier AS agent,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_amounts pm
    ON pm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holder ph
    ON ph.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN agent ag
    ON ag.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
ORDER BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number;

Question: What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder, premium amount paid, the catastrophe it had, and the agent who sold it?
Return agents and the policy they have sold that have had a claim and the corresponding expense reserve amount by agent id, policy number and claim number

SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
GROUP BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY
    apr.Party_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number;
